anya: Heads-up: quick canary of glacier-int4 shows ~4% more funcall JSON parse failures on streaming vs float. Mostly truncated suffixes. :grimacing:

sam: Truncated how? examples?

anya: Example from logs:
```
{"cmd":"update_user","args":{"id":123,"email":"x@y.com",},
...stream cut...
```

lee: Looks like mid-object stop. Could be EOS token shift after quant. Any token-align diffs?

maria: CI-bot, run structured-output-sanity on 300 recent canary samples for glacier-int4 and float baseline.

ci-bot: Running structured-output-sanity(300) for glacier-int4. ETA 90s.

sam: Short mitigation: enable canary-only json-repair that closes braces and strips trailing commas, but flag repaired outputs. Keep raw in logs.

lee: Also run a kv-cache-off canary to check cache interaction.

ci-bot: Results: glacier-int4 parse_success=91.8%, healed_success=3.9%, final_failure=4.3%. baseline parse_success=95.9%, healed_success=0.6%, final_failure=3.5%. Report: /canary/reports/glacier-int4/1799000001.json

maria: I'll prototype a tiny repair lib and dashboard for healed metrics. Prioritize token-align diff next to see punctuation/EOS shifts.

anya: Agreed. Hold rollout until parse+healed >= baseline_parse - 0.5% or we fix quant config. I'll post updates. :thumbsup:
